   358→            if self.time_integral.method == "discrete":
   359→                # discrete sum should be observed at the discrete times
   360→                t = self.time_integral.discrete_times
   361→            else:
   362→                # assume we can do a sufficiently accurate trapezoidal integration at t_pts
   363→                t = self.t_pts

   366→            np.asarray(t).size == len(self.t_pts) and np.all(t == self.t_pts)

   432→    def initialise_sensitivity_explicit_forward(self):
   433→        "Set up the sensitivity dictionary"
   434→
   435→        all_S_var = []
   436→        for ts, ys, inputs_stacked, inputs, base_variable, dy_dp in zip(
   437→            self.all_ts,
   438→            self.all_ys,
   439→            self.all_inputs_casadi,
   440→            self.all_inputs,
   441→            self.base_variables,
   442→            self.all_solution_sensitivities["all"],
   443→        ):
   444→            # Set up symbolic variables
   445→            t_casadi = casadi.MX.sym("t")
   446→            y_casadi = casadi.MX.sym("y", ys.shape[0])
   447→            p_casadi = {
   448→                name: casadi.MX.sym(name, value.shape[0])
   449→                for name, value in inputs.items()
   450→            }
   451→
   452→            p_casadi_stacked = casadi.vertcat(*[p for p in p_casadi.values()])
   453→
   454→            # Convert variable to casadi format for differentiating
   455→            var_casadi = base_variable.to_casadi(t_casadi, y_casadi, inputs=p_casadi)
   456→            dvar_dy = casadi.jacobian(var_casadi, y_casadi)
   457→            dvar_dp = casadi.jacobian(var_casadi, p_casadi_stacked)
   458→
   459→            # Convert to functions and evaluate index-by-index
   460→            dvar_dy_func = casadi.Function(
   461→                "dvar_dy", [t_casadi, y_casadi, p_casadi_stacked], [dvar_dy]
   462→            )
   463→            dvar_dp_func = casadi.Function(
   464→                "dvar_dp", [t_casadi, y_casadi, p_casadi_stacked], [dvar_dp]
   465→            )
   466→            for idx, t in enumerate(ts):
   467→                u = ys[:, idx]
   468→                next_dvar_dy_eval = dvar_dy_func(t, u, inputs_stacked)
   469→                next_dvar_dp_eval = dvar_dp_func(t, u, inputs_stacked)
   470→                if idx == 0:
   471→                    dvar_dy_eval = next_dvar_dy_eval
   472→                    dvar_dp_eval = next_dvar_dp_eval
   473→                else:
   474→                    dvar_dy_eval = casadi.diagcat(dvar_dy_eval, next_dvar_dy_eval)
   475→                    dvar_dp_eval = casadi.vertcat(dvar_dp_eval, next_dvar_dp_eval)
   476→
   477→            # Compute sensitivity
   478→            S_var = dvar_dy_eval @ dy_dp + dvar_dp_eval
   479→            all_S_var.append(S_var)
   480→
   481→        S_var = casadi.vertcat(*all_S_var)
   482→        sensitivities = {"all": S_var}
   483→
   484→        # Add the individual sensitivity
   485→        start = 0
   486→        for name, inp in self.all_inputs[0].items():
   487→            end = start + inp.shape[0]
   488→            sensitivities[name] = S_var[:, start:end]
   489→            start = end
   490→

   492→        self._sensitivities = sensitivities

   184→    def _extract_sensitivity_matrix(self, model, y):
   185→        n_states = model.len_rhs_and_alg
   186→        n_rhs = model.len_rhs
   187→        n_alg = model.len_alg
   188→        # Get the point where the algebraic equations start
   189→        if model.len_rhs != 0:
   190→            n_p = model.len_rhs_sens // model.len_rhs
   191→        else:
   192→            n_p = model.len_alg_sens // model.len_alg
   193→        len_rhs_and_sens = model.len_rhs + model.len_rhs_sens
   194→
   195→        # y gets the part of the solution vector that correspond to the
   196→        # actual ODE/DAE solution
   197→
   198→        # save sensitivities as a dictionary
   199→        # first save the whole sensitivity matrix
   200→        # reshape using Fortran order to get the right array:
   201→        #   t0_x0_p0, t0_x0_p1, ..., t0_x0_pn
   202→        #   t0_x1_p0, t0_x1_p1, ..., t0_x1_pn
   203→        #   ...
   204→        #   t0_xn_p0, t0_xn_p1, ..., t0_xn_pn
   205→        #   t1_x0_p0, t1_x0_p1, ..., t1_x0_pn
   206→        #   t1_x1_p0, t1_x1_p1, ..., t1_x1_pn
   207→        #   ...
   208→        #   t1_xn_p0, t1_xn_p1, ..., t1_xn_pn
   209→        #   ...
   210→        #   tn_x0_p0, tn_x0_p1, ..., tn_x0_pn
   211→        #   tn_x1_p0, tn_x1_p1, ..., tn_x1_pn
   212→        #   ...
   213→        #   tn_xn_p0, tn_xn_p1, ..., tn_xn_pn
   214→        # 1, Extract rhs and alg sensitivities and reshape into 3D matrices
   215→        # with shape (n_p, n_states, n_t)
   216→        if isinstance(y, casadi.DM):
   217→            y_full = y.full()
   218→        else:
   219→            y_full = y
   220→
   221→        n_t = y.shape[1]
   222→        ode_sens = y_full[n_rhs:len_rhs_and_sens, :].reshape(n_p, n_rhs, n_t)
   223→        alg_sens = y_full[len_rhs_and_sens + n_alg :, :].reshape(n_p, n_alg, n_t)
   224→        # 2. Concatenate into a single 3D matrix with shape (n_p, n_states, n_t)
   225→        # i.e. along first axis
   226→        full_sens_matrix = np.concatenate([ode_sens, alg_sens], axis=1)
   227→        # Transpose and reshape into a (n_states * n_t, n_p) matrix
   228→        full_sens_matrix = full_sens_matrix.transpose(2, 1, 0).reshape(
   229→            n_t * n_states, n_p
   230→        )
   231→
   232→        # convert back to casadi (todo: this is not very efficient, should refactor
   233→        # to avoid this)
   234→        full_sens_matrix = casadi.DM(full_sens_matrix)
   235→
   236→        y_dae = np.vstack(
   237→            [
   238→                y[: model.len_rhs, :],
   239→                y[len_rhs_and_sens : len_rhs_and_sens + model.len_alg, :],
   240→            ]
   241→        )
   242→        return y_dae, full_sens_matrix
   243→
   244→    def _extract_explicit_sensitivities(self, model, y, t_eval, inputs):
   245→        """
   246→        given a model and a solution y, extracts the sensitivities
   247→
   248→        Parameters
   249→        --------
   250→        model : :class:`pybamm.BaseModel`
   251→            A model that has been already setup by this base solver
   252→        y: ndarray
   253→            The solution of the full explicit sensitivity equations
   254→        t_eval: ndarray
   255→            The evaluation times
   256→        inputs: dict
   257→            parameter inputs
   258→
   259→        Returns
   260→        -------
   261→        y: ndarray
   262→            The solution of the ode/dae in model
   263→        sensitivities: dict of (string: ndarray)
   264→            A dictionary of parameter names, and the corresponding solution of
   265→            the sensitivity equations
   266→        """
   267→
   268→        y_dae, full_sens_matrix = self._extract_sensitivity_matrix(model, y)
   269→
   270→        # Save the full sensitivity matrix
   271→        sensitivity = {"all": full_sens_matrix}
   272→
   273→        # also save the sensitivity wrt each parameter (read the columns of the
   274→        # sensitivity matrix)
   275→        start = 0
   276→        for name in model.calculate_sensitivities:
   277→            inp = inputs[name]
   278→            input_size = inp.shape[0]
   279→            end = start + input_size
   280→            sensitivity[name] = full_sens_matrix[:, start:end]
   281→            start = end
   282→
   283→        return y_dae, sensitivity

   375→    def check_ys_are_not_too_large(self):
   376→        # Only check last one so that it doesn't take too long
   377→        # We only care about the cases where y is growing too large without any
   378→        # restraint, so if y gets large in the middle then comes back down that is ok
   379→        y, model = self.all_ys[-1], self.all_models[-1]

   382→            for var in [*model.rhs.keys(), *model.algebraic.keys()]:
   383→                var = model.variables[var.name]

   386→                for node in var.pre_order():

   391→                if statevector is None:  # pragma: no cover

   394→                    )

   396→                if np.any(y_var > pybamm.settings.max_y_value):

   399→                        f"of `{pybamm.settings.max_y_value}. This could be due to "
   400→                        "incorrect scaling, model formulation, or "
   401→                        "parameter values. The maximum allowed value is set by "

   592→    def _update_variable(self, variable):
   593→        time_integral = None
   594→        pybamm.logger.debug(f"Post-processing {variable}")
   595→        vars_pybamm = [
   596→            model.variables_and_events[variable] for model in self.all_models
   597→        ]
   598→
   599→        # Iterate through all models, some may be in the list several times and
   600→        # therefore only get set up once
   601→        vars_casadi = []
   602→        for i, (model, ys, inputs, var_pybamm) in enumerate(
   603→            zip(self.all_models, self.all_ys, self.all_inputs, vars_pybamm)
   604→        ):
   605→            if self.variables_returned and var_pybamm.has_symbol_of_classes(
   606→                pybamm.expression_tree.state_vector.StateVector
   607→            ):
   608→                raise KeyError(
   609→                    f"Cannot process variable '{variable}' as it was not part of the "
   610→                    "solve. Please re-run the solve with `output_variables` set to "
   611→                    "include this variable."
   612→                )
   613→            elif isinstance(
   614→                var_pybamm, (pybamm.ExplicitTimeIntegral, pybamm.DiscreteTimeSum)
   615→            ):
   616→                time_integral = pybamm.ProcessedVariableTimeIntegral.from_pybamm_var(
   617→                    var_pybamm
   618→                )
   619→                var_pybamm = var_pybamm.child
   620→                if variable in model._variables_casadi:
   621→                    var_casadi = model._variables_casadi[variable]
   622→                else:
   623→                    var_casadi = self.process_casadi_var(
   624→                        var_pybamm,
   625→                        inputs,
   626→                        ys.shape,
   627→                    )
   628→                    model._variables_casadi[variable] = var_casadi
   629→                vars_pybamm[i] = var_pybamm
   630→            elif variable in model._variables_casadi:
   631→                var_casadi = model._variables_casadi[variable]
   632→            else:
   633→                var_casadi = self.process_casadi_var(
   634→                    var_pybamm,
   635→                    inputs,
   636→                    ys.shape,
   637→                )
   638→                model._variables_casadi[variable] = var_casadi
   639→            vars_casadi.append(var_casadi)
   640→        var = pybamm.process_variable(
   641→            vars_pybamm, vars_casadi, self, time_integral=time_integral
   642→        )
   643→
   644→        self._variables[variable] = var

   646→    def process_casadi_var(self, var_pybamm, inputs, ys_shape):
   647→        t_MX = casadi.MX.sym("t")
   648→        y_MX = casadi.MX.sym("y", ys_shape[0])
   649→        inputs_MX_dict = {
   650→            key: casadi.MX.sym("input", value.shape[0]) for key, value in inputs.items()
   651→        }
   652→        inputs_MX = casadi.vertcat(*[p for p in inputs_MX_dict.values()])
   653→        var_sym = var_pybamm.to_casadi(t_MX, y_MX, inputs=inputs_MX_dict)
   654→
   655→        opts = {
   656→            "cse": True,
   657→            "inputs_check": False,
   658→            "is_diff_in": [False, False, False],
   659→            "is_diff_out": [False],
   660→            "regularity_check": False,
   661→            "error_on_fail": False,
   662→            "enable_jacobian": False,
   663→        }
   664→
   665→        # Casadi has a bug where it does not correctly handle arrays with
   666→        # zeros padded at the beginning or end. To avoid this, we add and
   667→        # subtract the same number to the variable to reinforce the
   668→        # variable bounds. This does not affect the answer
   669→        epsilon = 1.0
   670→        var_sym = (var_sym - epsilon) + epsilon
   671→
   672→        var_casadi = casadi.Function(
   673→            "variable",
   674→            [t_MX, y_MX, inputs_MX],
   675→            [var_sym],

import numpy as np
import pybamm
import pytest


def test_meshless_variables_added_postbuild():
    # Build a simple fast model (base model without spatial meshes)
    model = pybamm.BaseModel()
    # Add a trivial rhs to have a state vector of size 1
    y = pybamm.Variable("y")
    model.rhs = {y: -y}
    model.initial_conditions = {y: pybamm.Scalar(1.0)}

    # Discretise minimal geometry-free model
    disc = pybamm.Discretisation()
    disc.process_model(model)

    # Solve quickly for a short time
    t_eval = np.linspace(0, 1, 5)
    # Use Scikits.odes or Casadi fallback; let PyBaMM choose default solver
    solver = pybamm.ScipySolver()

    # After building but before solving, add meshless variables
    model.variables.update({
        "t squared": pybamm.t ** 2,
        "const": pybamm.Scalar(3.14),
        "expr": 2 * pybamm.t + pybamm.Scalar(1),
    })

    sol = solver.solve(model, t_eval)

    # Access added variables; they should not raise AttributeError and return arrays
    tsq = sol["t squared"].data
    const = sol["const"].data
    expr = sol["expr"].data

    assert tsq.shape == (t_eval.shape[0],)
    assert const.shape == (t_eval.shape[0],)
    assert expr.shape == (t_eval.shape[0],)

    np.testing.assert_allclose(tsq, t_eval ** 2)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(const, np.full_like(t_eval, 3.14))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(expr, 2 * t_eval + 1)

    # Also check interpolation sensibly at a few times
    np.testing.assert_allclose(sol["t squared"](t_eval[::2]), (t_eval[::2]) ** 2)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(sol["expr"](t_eval[1]), 2 * t_eval[1] + 1)

   370→        if self.time_integral is not None:

   423→        """
   424→        Returns a dictionary of sensitivities for each input parameter.
   425→        The keys are the input parameters, and the value is a matrix of size
   426→        (n_x * n_t, n_p), where n_x is the number of states, n_t is the number of time
   427→        points, and n_p is the size of the input parameter
   428→        """

   431→            return {}
   432→        # Otherwise initialise and return sensitivities
   433→        if self._sensitivities is None:
   434→            if self.all_solution_sensitivities:
   435→                self.initialise_sensitivity_explicit_forward()
   436→            else:
   437→                raise ValueError(
   438→                    "Cannot compute sensitivities. The 'calculate_sensitivities' "
   439→                    "argument of the solver.solve should be changed from 'None' to "
   440→                    "allow sensitivities calculations. Check solver documentation for "
   441→                    "details."
   442→                )

   445→    def initialise_sensitivity_explicit_forward(self):
   446→        "Set up the sensitivity dictionary"
   447→
   448→        all_S_var = []
   449→        for ts, ys, inputs_stacked, inputs, base_variable, dy_dp in zip(
   450→            self.all_ts,
   451→            self.all_ys,
   452→            self.all_inputs_casadi,
   453→            self.all_inputs,
   454→            self.base_variables,
   455→            self.all_solution_sensitivities["all"],
   456→        ):
   457→            # Set up symbolic variables
   458→            t_casadi = casadi.MX.sym("t")
   459→            y_casadi = casadi.MX.sym("y", ys.shape[0])
   460→            p_casadi = {
   461→                name: casadi.MX.sym(name, value.shape[0])
   462→                for name, value in inputs.items()
   463→            }
   464→
   465→            p_casadi_stacked = casadi.vertcat(*[p for p in p_casadi.values()])
   466→
   467→            # Convert variable to casadi format for differentiating
   468→            var_casadi = base_variable.to_casadi(t_casadi, y_casadi, inputs=p_casadi)
   469→            dvar_dy = casadi.jacobian(var_casadi, y_casadi)
   470→            dvar_dp = casadi.jacobian(var_casadi, p_casadi_stacked)
   471→
   472→            # Convert to functions and evaluate index-by-index
   473→            dvar_dy_func = casadi.Function(
   474→                "dvar_dy", [t_casadi, y_casadi, p_casadi_stacked], [dvar_dy]
   475→            )
   476→            dvar_dp_func = casadi.Function(
   477→                "dvar_dp", [t_casadi, y_casadi, p_casadi_stacked], [dvar_dp]
   478→            )
   479→            for idx, t in enumerate(ts):
   480→                u = ys[:, idx]
   481→                next_dvar_dy_eval = dvar_dy_func(t, u, inputs_stacked)
   482→                next_dvar_dp_eval = dvar_dp_func(t, u, inputs_stacked)
   483→                if idx == 0:
   484→                    dvar_dy_eval = next_dvar_dy_eval
   485→                    dvar_dp_eval = next_dvar_dp_eval
   486→                else:
   487→                    dvar_dy_eval = casadi.diagcat(dvar_dy_eval, next_dvar_dy_eval)
   488→                    dvar_dp_eval = casadi.vertcat(dvar_dp_eval, next_dvar_dp_eval)
   489→
   490→            # Compute sensitivity
   491→            S_var = dvar_dy_eval @ dy_dp + dvar_dp_eval
   492→            all_S_var.append(S_var)
   493→
   494→        S_var = casadi.vertcat(*all_S_var)
   495→        sensitivities = {"all": S_var}
   496→
   497→        # Add the individual sensitivity
   498→        start = 0
   499→        for name, inp in self.all_inputs[0].items():
   500→            end = start + inp.shape[0]
   501→            sensitivities[name] = S_var[:, start:end]
   502→            start = end
   503→
   504→        # Save attribute
   505→        self._sensitivities = sensitivities
